title: Start over: Koh Samet and the Poles
kaylee: Coming back to Koh Samet or the Poles mid-story, a small pill at the top lets you start the story from the beginning. It hides itself after 10 seconds, and a quick tap does nothing: you hold it for a second.

pictures.title: The Poles: back on the globe mid-story
pictures.caption: Top center, level with the top bar; a thin bar under it runs out over 10 seconds

pictures.title: Holding it
pictures.caption: A pink ring fills round the arrow; let go early and it just wiggles

pictures.title: The Poles, started over
pictures.caption: Stamps back to 0/5 and Pebble's way-in film plays (the trophy stays)
